scope: Only development law questions L-TA-01 through L-TA-15; prior holdout excluded from tuning

decisions.reason: The new interpretation does not replace the existing core rules asked here. Retirement-age lost earnings and death during litigation add narrower prerequisites absent from these questions; do not indiscriminately mark all new provisions relevant.

The question asks scope and calculation limits of dependent living expenses; article 8 clarifies the cap when there are multiple dependents. Conditional supplementary relevance; the question does not explicitly state multiple dependents. Report this alternative separately, not by rewriting frozen scores.
The new interpretation supplies no local statistical amount, injury-specific facts or complete final calculation.
Unspecified accident time and procedural posture still prevent choosing an applicable version. Article 12 introduces a case-stage requirement, not permission to blindly use the newest standard.
The stipulated already-completed historical case cannot be reopened or recalculated solely using the new explanation; article 12 expressly excludes retrial of previously final cases.
Road traffic interpretation does not cover international aviation delay conventions.
